name: Build, Push, and Deploy to VPS

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build and push Functions image (v3.0)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./CoffeeNChill.Functions
          file: ./CoffeeNChill.Functions/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: chengedock/coffeechill-functions:v3.0

      - name: Build and push Gateway image (v1.0)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./CoffeeNChill.Gateway
          file: ./CoffeeNChill.Gateway/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: chengedock/coffeechill-gateway:v1.0

      - name: Deploy to Linux VPS
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.VPS_USERNAME }}
          key: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd /opt/coffeenchill
            docker compose pull
            docker compose up -d --remove-orphans
            docker image prune -f
